learning_outcomes.text: Provide information about cavitation, radial and axial hydraulic pumps and turbines.

syllabus_topics: Flow pattern and energy transfer in the impeller
Solving problems related to cavitation, energy conversion and transfer
Pump Characteristic Curves, parallel and series connection
Problem solving with parallel and series connection in pumps
Kaplan Turbine and Kaplan Turbine and Propeller Impeller Design
Problems related to Propeller Impeller Design
